notes.title: DEMO 0.0.3 Update is out now!
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Demo 0.0.3:

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where save data (stage completion and settings) was not persisting when you closed and reopened the game

Updates:
- You can now use either W,A,S,D keys or Arrow keys for movement/menu navigation
- You can now use either SPACEBAR or ENTER key for the attack/menu selection
- Non-Boss stages now show Progress % on the HUD instead of the Boss Health meter
- All stages are shorter
- Attack charge time reduced from 12/24/36 seconds to 6/12/18 seconds for Easy/Normal/Hard modes
- Enemy hitboxes reduced by a couple pixels for fairer collisions
- Improvements/changes to Boss AI
- Improvements/changes to Game Over screen
- Improvements/changes to Stage Select screen
